title: 第一卷 风起时 第十一章 若与人为敌当永除后患第一卷 风起时 第十二章 凝气五层

杜小康在情绪稍微平静后，发现自己的脸肿成那样，又是一阵恼怒与委屈，又觉得见不了人。
于是她哭着回到了自己的院落，闭门疗伤去了。
谢禾与陈航在告辞一声后，同样回往了各自的院落。
他们伤得都不轻，也需要疗伤。
在离去前，他们告诉陈风奇可以在村子里随便逛。
陈风奇独自来到了湖边，抬头就能看到在那应劫之物麻球上，依然酣睡着的邋遢少女。
他并没有去惊动对方，转而仔细看向了应劫之物本身。
整个应劫之物，由粗大的麻绳缠绕而成，每一根都比人还要粗。
不过也有的麻绳，似在漫长的岁月下被逐渐腐朽，出现了断裂。
之前陈航他们所用的长鞭，应该就是那些断裂的麻绳制成。
陈风奇不禁想起了百丈山的应劫古剑，或许这些麻绳，并不是真正的应劫之物。
真正的应劫之物，说不定是缠绕在麻绳中央的什么其他东西。
恰似应劫古剑，还是在裹剑布腐朽之后，才逐渐显露出剑身。
随后他低下头，看向了湖泊，看到了湖水倒映中的自己。
当他看到自己肿得老大的半边脸颊，以及两个明显淤青的双眼后，不由嘴角抽动。
“明明你们下手更狠！”
嘟囔了一句后，他干脆在这湖岸边盘坐下来，也开始运转修为给自己疗伤。
在修为的运转下，身体传来的疼痛立刻减轻了许多。
好在都是些皮外伤，没什么内伤，应该用不了多久就能痊愈。

这个时候，他才开始仔细感受自身在服用宝药后，所带来的变化。
首先是修为提升了许多，距离凝气四层更近了。
或许再来一株三尺灵光的宝药，就能让他完成突破。
还有肉身，也得到了全方面的提升，感觉身体中蕴含的力量，要比以前强了许多。
这也不枉他又是对付异兽，又是与大鼎村的几人厮杀，最后还受宝药影响，险些被愤怒吞噬了理智。
大概也就是一个时辰左右，陈风奇身上的伤就已经陆陆续续消失，差不多痊愈了。
这不仅是他运转修为疗伤的结果，也得益于吃了不少宝药，肉身经过强化之后，恢复速度也快了许多。
当他睁眼时，刚好就看到了一条游鱼自湖水中跃出，又落入水中，荡起层层涟漪。
“那就是鱼吗？”
他舔了舔嘴唇，眼神直勾勾盯着水面涟漪处，有些想要抓两条上来尝尝味道。
可忽然，有一条丝线落入水中，将那条刚落下的鱼，又给重新捞了起来。
陈风奇心中一惊，连忙抬头看去，才发现邋遢少女不知何时已经醒来。
那条丝线，正是出自她的手中，完全由修为凝聚而成。
她轻轻一扯，鱼已经飞上应劫之物，落入掌中，修为丝线也随之消散。
邋遢少女看着手中不断摆动挣扎的游鱼，眨了眨眼，低头就是一口。

After Du Xiaokang calmed down a little, he found that his face was swollen like that. He felt angry and aggrieved again, and felt that he couldn't see anyone.
So she cried and returned to her courtyard to heal her wounds behind closed doors.
After saying goodbye, Xie He and Chen Hang also returned to their respective courtyards.
他们伤得都不轻，也需要疗伤。
Before leaving, they told Chen Fengqi that he could wander around the village.
Chen Fengqi came to the lake alone. When he looked up, he could see the sloppy girl still sleeping soundly on the sesame ball.
He did not alarm the other party, but looked carefully at the object itself.
The entire thing that should be robbed is made of thick hemp ropes, each one thicker than a human being.
However, some of the hemp ropes seemed to have gradually decayed and broken over the years.
The long whips used by Chen Hang and the others before were probably made from broken hemp ropes.
Chen Fengqi couldn't help but think of the ancient sword Ying Jie in Baizhang Mountain. Perhaps these hemp ropes were not the real Ying Jie objects.
The real thing that should be robbed might be something else wrapped in the center of the hemp rope.
Just like the Ying Jie ancient sword, the sword body was gradually revealed after the cloth wrapping the sword decayed.
Then he lowered his head, looked at the lake, and saw himself reflected in the lake water.
When he saw half of his swollen cheeks and two obviously bruised eyes, he couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth.
“明明你们下手更狠！”
After muttering something, he simply sat down on the shore of the lake and began to use his cultivation to heal himself.
Under the operation of cultivation, the pain in the body immediately eased a lot.
Fortunately, they were all superficial injuries, no internal injuries, and they should be healed in a short time.
At this time, he began to carefully feel the changes brought about by taking the precious medicine.
First of all, his cultivation has improved a lot, and he is closer to the fourth level of Qi Condensation.
Perhaps another treasure with three feet of spiritual light will allow him to complete his breakthrough.
The physical body has also been improved in all aspects. It feels like the power contained in the body is much stronger than before.
It is not in vain that he dealt with strange beasts and fought with several people from Dading Village. In the end, he was affected by the treasure and almost lost his sanity with anger.
In about an hour, Chen Fengqi's injuries gradually disappeared and he was almost healed.
This is not only the result of his cultivation and healing, but also the result of taking a lot of precious medicine. After the physical body has been strengthened, the recovery speed is also much faster.
When he opened his eyes, he just saw a fish jumping out of the lake and falling into the water, making ripples.
"Is that a fish?"
He licked his lips and stared straight at the ripples in the water, wanting to grab two and taste them.
But suddenly, a silk thread fell into the water, and the fish that had just fallen was picked up again.
Chen Fengqi was startled and quickly looked up, only to find that the sloppy girl had woken up at some point.
That silk thread came from her hands and was completely condensed by cultivation.
She pulled it gently, and the fish flew onto the target and fell into her palm, and the thread of cultivation dissipated.
The sloppy girl looked at the struggling fish in her hand, blinked, lowered her head and took a sip.
